title: Community Pool Back Open Just in Time for Summer Following Major Renovations
description: SAN DIEGO – The first phase of renovations to the Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Swimming Pool in South Encanto will be celebrated Wednesday, June 3, at a special ribbon cutting ceremony and community day with Councilmember Henry L. Foster III, Parks and Recreation Department leaders and other community partners. The pool reopened to the public today after being closed since November 2024.
